1.subtitle: What is Budgeting?
1.text: Budgeting is the process of creating a plan to spend your money. This spending plan is called a budget. Creating this spending plan allows you to determine in advance whether you will have enough money to do the things you need to do or would like to do.

1.subtitle: 50/30/20 Method
1.text: One of the most popular methods is 50/30/20. Allocate 50% of your income for Needs, 30% for Wants, and 20% for Savings or Debt.

1.subtitle: How to Start
1.text: 1. Record all income. 2. List all fixed expenses. 3. Evaluate variable expenses. 4. Adjust the allocation to match your financial targets.

2.subtitle: Why an Emergency Fund?
2.text: An emergency fund is money set aside specifically to cover living expenses when something unexpected happens, such as job loss or sudden medical bills.

2.subtitle: How Much Do You Need?
2.text: Ideally, have 3-6 months of living expenses. If your monthly expenses are Rp 5 million, then your emergency fund target should be Rp 15-30 million.
